## Load Raw Data

```{r}
# 2. Load the dataset from this directory
df <- read_csv("Raw\\Flempton_all_data_30.04.25.csv")
```

---

## Define Physical Constants

```{r}
# 3. Define Physical Constants from the Excel
V  <- 0.00967    # Chamber Volume (m3)
A  <- 0.0314     # Soil Surface Area (m2)
Va_std <- 0.0224 # Standard Molar Volume at 0°C (m3/mol)
R <- 8.314       # Ideal Gas Constant (J/(mol·K))
```

---

## Define Auto-Selection Function

```{r}
# 4. Define the Auto-Selection Function
# This function tests points 2-8, 2-7, and 3-8 to find the best linear R-squared
get_best_slope <- function(time, gas) {
  # We define the windows we want to test (indices of the measurements)
  windows <- list(2:8, 2:7, 3:8, 3:7)
  
  best_r2 <- -1
  best_slope <- 0
  
  for (w in windows) {
    # Ensure we actually have these points in the data
    if (max(w) <= length(gas)) {
      model <- lm(gas[w] ~ time[w])
      r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared
      
      # Decision: If this window has a better fit, save it
      if (r2 > best_r2) {
        best_r2 <- r2
        best_slope <- coef(model)[2]
      }
    }
  }
  return(best_slope)
}
```

---

## Calculate Fluxes with Auto-Selection

```{r}
# 5. Processing with Auto-Selection
flux_results <- df %>%
  group_by(Plot) %>%
  arrange(time_in_secs) %>%
  summarise(
    # Use the new function to pick the best slope automatically
    slope_CO2 = get_best_slope(time_in_secs, `Carbon dioxide CO2`),
    slope_N2O = get_best_slope(time_in_secs, `Nitrous oxide N2O`),
    
    # Soil variables
    soil_temp_C = first(Temperature),
    mean_moisture = mean(c(first(Moisture_Rep1), first(Moisture_Rep2), first(Moisture_Rep3))),
    
    # Calculate Pressure (used for Refined Va)
    avg_pressure_pa = mean(Pressure, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    temp_K = soil_temp_C + 273.15,
    Va_refined = (R * temp_K) / avg_pressure_pa,
    
    # Outputs
    flux_CO2_refined = slope_CO2 * (V / (A * Va_refined)),
    flux_N2O_refined = (slope_N2O * (V / (A * Va_refined))) * 298
  )
```

## Load and Merge Datasets

```{r}
# 7. Load the data
flux_data <- read_csv("Raw\\Flempton_Calculated_Fluxes_AutoSelected.csv")

# Load the original flux data (the manual Excel results)
# Note: Cleaning the column names as they have trailing spaces
# We use trimws to automatically fix "Plot ", "Treatment ", etc.
original_flux_data <- read_csv("Raw\\Flempton_product_gasmet_flux_30.04.25.csv") %>%

  rename_with(trimws) %>% 
  select(Plot, flux_CO2_original = CO2, flux_N2O_original = N2O) %>%
  mutate(Plot = as.character(Plot))

# Load randomization
trial_book <- here("Raw\\Flempton_Nitrogen_product_Trial_book_2025.xlsx")
randomisation <- read_excel(trial_book, sheet = "Plot randomisation") %>%
  rename(Plot = `Plot number`) %>%
  mutate(Plot = as.character(Plot))

# Load Treatments sheet 
# FIX: We use the suffixed names R created to resolve the duplicate column conflict
treatments <- read_excel(trial_book, sheet = "Treatments_fert calc", skip = 1) %>%
  select(Treatment = `Treatment number...1`, Product = `Product...2`) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  # Remove any empty rows from the bottom of the Excel sheet
  filter(!is.na(Treatment)) %>% 
  mutate(Product = case_when(
    Product == "Organic matter based product 1" ~ "OM1",
    Product == "Organic matter based product 2" ~ "OM2",
    TRUE ~ Product
  ))
```

---

## Merge All Data

```{r}
# 8. Merge all data
# Note: Using the ...1 and ...2 suffixes for the Treatment sheet as R identified them
analysis_df <- flux_data %>%
  mutate(Plot = as.character(Plot)) %>%
  left_join(original_flux_data, by = "Plot") %>%
  left_join(randomisation, by = "Plot") %>%
  # Ensure treatment numbers match before joining names
  mutate(Treatment = as.numeric(Treatment)) %>%
  left_join(treatments, by = "Treatment")
```

## Visualize Original vs Refined Flux Methods

```{r}
# 9. Visualisation
# We pivot the data so we can plot "Original" and "Refined" side-by-side
comparison_plot_data <- analysis_df %>%
  select(Plot, Product, flux_N2O_refined, flux_N2O_original) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("flux_N2O"), 
               names_to = "Method", 
               values_to = "N2O_Flux") %>%
  mutate(Method = if_else(Method == "flux_N2O_refined", 
                          "Refined (R + Soil Temp)", 
                          "Original (Excel Standard)"))

# Side-by-Side Comparison
ggplot(comparison_plot_data, aes(x = Product, y = N2O_Flux, fill = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(title = "LCA Impact: Original vs. Refined N2O Flux",
       subtitle = "Flempton Trial - Demonstrating the correction from 0°C to Soil Temp",
       x = "Fertilizer Product",
       y = expression(N[2]*O ~ Flux ~ (mu*mol ~ CO[2]*e / m^2 / s))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#D3D3D3", "#2E8B57")) # Gray for old, Green for your new refined data

# Save the plot for your records
ggsave("Figures\\Flux_Method_Comparison.png", width = 10, height = 7)
```

## Morning vs Evening Comparison

```{r}
# Extract time of day and create morning/evening categories
# Define morning as measurements before 12:00 noon
# and evening as measurements from 12:00 onwards

morning_evening_data <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract hour from Time column
    hour = as.numeric(substr(Time, 1, 2)),
    time_of_day = if_else(hour < 12, "Morning (Before Noon)", "Evening (Noon Onwards)")
  ) %>%
  group_by(Plot, time_of_day) %>%
  summarise(
    # Calculate flux for morning and evening measurements
    slope_CO2 = get_best_slope(time_in_secs, `Carbon dioxide CO2`),
    slope_N2O = get_best_slope(time_in_secs, `Nitrous oxide N2O`),
    soil_temp_C = first(Temperature),
    mean_moisture = mean(c(first(Moisture_Rep1), first(Moisture_Rep2), first(Moisture_Rep3))),
    avg_pressure_pa = mean(Pressure, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    temp_K = soil_temp_C + 273.15,
    Va_refined = (R * temp_K) / avg_pressure_pa,
    flux_CO2 = slope_CO2 * (V / (A * Va_refined)),
    flux_N2O = (slope_N2O * (V / (A * Va_refined))) * 298,
    Time = first(Time),  # Include time for labels
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Plot = as.character(Plot)) %>%
  left_join(randomisation, by = "Plot") %>%
  mutate(Treatment = as.numeric(Treatment)) %>%
  left_join(treatments, by = "Treatment")

head(morning_evening_data)
```

```{r}
# Create comparison plots for morning vs evening measurements
# First, calculate p-values for each product using ggsignif package

# CO2 Flux Comparison
co2_comparison <- ggplot(morning_evening_data, aes(x = Product, y = flux_CO2, fill = time_of_day)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "CO2 Flux: Morning vs Evening Measurements",
    x = "Fertilizer Product",
    y = expression(CO[2] ~ Flux ~ (mu*mol ~ m^-2 ~ s^-1)),
    fill = "Time of Day"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Morning (Before Noon)" = "#FFD700", "Evening (Noon Onwards)" = "#FF8C00"))

# Add p-value annotations with brackets for each product
products <- unique(morning_evening_data$Product)
for (i in seq_along(products)) {
  prod <- products[i]
  product_data <- morning_evening_data %>% filter(Product == prod)
  
  morning_data <- product_data %>% filter(time_of_day == "Morning (Before Noon)") %>% pull(flux_CO2)
  evening_data <- product_data %>% filter(time_of_day == "Evening (Noon Onwards)") %>% pull(flux_CO2)
  
  if (length(morning_data) > 0 & length(evening_data) > 0) {
    test_result <- t.test(morning_data, evening_data)
    p_val <- test_result$p.value
    y_pos <- max(c(morning_data, evening_data), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.12
    
    # Add bracket and p-value annotation
    co2_comparison <- co2_comparison +
      annotate("segment", x = i - 0.2, xend = i + 0.2, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos, 
               color = "black", size = 0.5) +
      annotate("text", x = i, y = y_pos * 1.05, 
               label = paste0("p = ", format.pval(p_val, digits = 2)),
               hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0, size = 3, fontface = "bold")
  }
}

print(co2_comparison)
ggsave("Figures\\CO2_Morning_vs_Evening.png", width = 10, height = 6)
```

## Statistical Analysis: Morning vs Evening Comparisons

```{r}
# Perform two-way ANOVA for CO2 and N2O
# Factors: Product and Time of Day

# CO2 Two-way ANOVA
co2_anova <- aov(flux_CO2 ~ Product * time_of_day, data = morning_evening_data)
co2_anova_summary <- summary(co2_anova)

cat("\n=== CO2 FLUX: Two-Way ANOVA Results ===\n")
print(co2_anova_summary)

# N2O Two-way ANOVA
n2o_anova <- aov(flux_N2O ~ Product * time_of_day, data = morning_evening_data)
n2o_anova_summary <- summary(n2o_anova)

cat("\n=== N2O FLUX: Two-Way ANOVA Results ===\n")
print(n2o_anova_summary)
```

```{r}
# T-tests for each product comparing morning vs evening
# Install broom package if needed for clean output
library(broom)

# Prepare results dataframe
ttest_results <- data.frame()

for (prod in unique(morning_evening_data$Product)) {
  product_data <- morning_evening_data %>% 
    filter(Product == prod)
  
  morning_co2 <- product_data %>% 
    filter(time_of_day == "Morning (Before Noon)") %>% 
    pull(flux_CO2)
  
  evening_co2 <- product_data %>% 
    filter(time_of_day == "Evening (Noon Onwards)") %>% 
    pull(flux_CO2)
  
  morning_n2o <- product_data %>% 
    filter(time_of_day == "Morning (Before Noon)") %>% 
    pull(flux_N2O)
  
  evening_n2o <- product_data %>% 
    filter(time_of_day == "Evening (Noon Onwards)") %>% 
    pull(flux_N2O)
  
  # T-tests
  if (length(morning_co2) > 0 & length(evening_co2) > 0) {
    co2_test <- t.test(morning_co2, evening_co2)
    ttest_results <- rbind(ttest_results, data.frame(
      Product = prod,
      Gas = "CO2",
      t_statistic = round(co2_test$statistic, 3),
      p_value = round(co2_test$p.value, 4),
      significant = ifelse(co2_test$p.value < 0.05, "Yes *", "No")
    ))
  }
  
  if (length(morning_n2o) > 0 & length(evening_n2o) > 0) {
    n2o_test <- t.test(morning_n2o, evening_n2o)
    ttest_results <- rbind(ttest_results, data.frame(
      Product = prod,
      Gas = "N2O",
      t_statistic = round(n2o_test$statistic, 3),
      p_value = round(n2o_test$p.value, 4),
      significant = ifelse(n2o_test$p.value < 0.05, "Yes *", "No")
    ))
  }
}

knitr::kable(ttest_results, 
             caption = "T-Test Results: Morning vs Evening by Product (α = 0.05). * indicates p < 0.05",
             digits = 4)
```

```{r}
# Effect sizes (Cohen's d) for morning vs evening differences
cohens_d <- function(x, y) {
  nx <- length(x)
  ny <- length(y)
  dof <- nx + ny - 2
  return(
    (mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
      sqrt(((nx-1)*sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)^2 + (ny-1)*sd(y, na.rm = TRUE)^2) / dof)
  )
}

effect_sizes <- data.frame()

for (prod in unique(morning_evening_data$Product)) {
  product_data <- morning_evening_data %>% 
    filter(Product == prod)
  
  morning_co2 <- product_data %>% 
    filter(time_of_day == "Morning (Before Noon)") %>% 
    pull(flux_CO2)
  
  evening_co2 <- product_data %>% 
    filter(time_of_day == "Evening (Noon Onwards)") %>% 
    pull(flux_CO2)
  
  morning_n2o <- product_data %>% 
    filter(time_of_day == "Morning (Before Noon)") %>% 
    pull(flux_N2O)
  
  evening_n2o <- product_data %>% 
    filter(time_of_day == "Evening (Noon Onwards)") %>% 
    pull(flux_N2O)
  
  if (length(morning_co2) > 0 & length(evening_co2) > 0) {
    effect_sizes <- rbind(effect_sizes, data.frame(
      Product = prod,
      Gas = "CO2",
      Cohens_d = round(cohens_d(morning_co2, evening_co2), 3),
      Effect_Size = case_when(
        abs(cohens_d(morning_co2, evening_co2)) < 0.2 ~ "Negligible",
        abs(cohens_d(morning_co2, evening_co2)) < 0.5 ~ "Small",
        abs(cohens_d(morning_co2, evening_co2)) < 0.8 ~ "Medium",
        TRUE ~ "Large"
      )
    ))
  }
  
  if (length(morning_n2o) > 0 & length(evening_n2o) > 0) {
    effect_sizes <- rbind(effect_sizes, data.frame(
      Product = prod,
      Gas = "N2O",
      Cohens_d = round(cohens_d(morning_n2o, evening_n2o), 3),
      Effect_Size = case_when(
        abs(cohens_d(morning_n2o, evening_n2o)) < 0.2 ~ "Negligible",
        abs(cohens_d(morning_n2o, evening_n2o)) < 0.5 ~ "Small",
        abs(cohens_d(morning_n2o, evening_n2o)) < 0.8 ~ "Medium",
        TRUE ~ "Large"
      )
    ))
  }
}

knitr::kable(effect_sizes, 
             caption = "Effect Sizes (Cohen's d) for Morning vs Evening Differences by Product",
             digits = 3)
```
